# Native v20 — bound target effect and real challenge endpoint

The five unchanged 2.8.122 packet files retain the exposed 39-action/57-gesture
failure. Exact sources, lengths and hashes are in [provenance.json](provenance.json).
This is regression evidence, not a holdout. The final original shows Boards
cleared 2/2 and Perfect; it does not yet show Challenge Complete.

Removing board_count_target_clear and restoring profile_id gives exact decoded
v19. No glyph, tolerance, scene, modal, stock or ordinary absence policy changes.
Explicit schema-2 true opt-in and the prior Boards calibration are mandatory.
The target entry requires empty independent replay, exactly one bound Boards
increment, original scene/modal/piles and 28 complete 60 × 4 felt bands. Slots
0–20 use y + 4; slots 21–27 use y + 164, the existing normal-final geometry.
All 6,720 pixels pass in the final original; the flying original fails 999 and
independent scene checks. Legacy Perfect and intermediate Boards retain their
old geometry. This is card-effect evidence only, retiring further card input
while the serial controller independently waits for the actual terminal.

The genuine Boards 2/2 Challenge Complete original and full Continue/header
crops, plus the genuine Fours XP skip-instruction crop, have source hashes in
provenance. Continue remains operator-owned. Cold completed Boards 2/2 adds no
active rank labels and infers no arbitrary requirements.

The native adapter independently solves/replays the saved 39-action exact route.
Synthetic all-kind session, whole-action, missing-control and XP-to-Continue
with optional-LevelUp tests remain labelled compositions. None are fresh Beast
verification, live ACK evidence, new acquisition receipts or permission to retry
uncertain input. The two-second window, STOP/context and budgets remain fixed.
